# Signal OS - Stakeholder Communication Templates

**Generated by:** audience-adapter skill
**Audiences:** CEO/Investors, Engineering, Customers, Partners
**Purpose:** Clear communication across all stakeholder levels

---

## 1. CEO / Board Executive Summary

**When to use:** Weekly updates, board meetings, fundraising
**Tone:** Strategic, metric-focused, forward-looking

### Weekly Executive Brief

```
SIGNAL OS — WEEK OF [DATE]
Classification: Internal

HEADLINES
- [Top 3 items only — what's changed, what's at risk, what needs decision]

METRICS AT A GLANCE
┌──────────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┐
│ Metric       │ Target │ Actual │ Status │
├──────────────┼────────┼────────┼────────┤
│ MAU          │ 5,000  │ X,XXX  │ 🟢/🟡/🔴 │
│ MRR          │ $15K   │ $X,XXX │ 🟢/🟡/🔴 │
│ Scoring p99  │ <500ms │ XXXms  │ 🟢/🟡/🔴 │
│ Uptime       │ 99.9%  │ XX.X%  │ 🟢/🟡/🔴 │
└──────────────┴────────┴────────┴────────┘

WHAT'S WORKING
- [1-2 bullets, data-backed]

WHAT NEEDS ATTENTION
- [1-2 bullets, with proposed solutions]

DECISIONS NEEDED
- [Specific asks with options and recommendations]

NEXT WEEK PRIORITIES
- [Top 3 priorities]

— [Name], [Title]
```

---

## 2. Engineering Team Update

**When to use:** Sprint reviews, technical standups
**Tone:** Technical but concise, action-oriented

### Sprint Review Template

```
SPRINT [NN] REVIEW — [Start Date] to [End Date]

SHIPPED
✅ [Feature/task] — [Brief description, link to PR]
✅ [Feature/task] — [Brief description]

IN PROGRESS
🔄 [Feature/task] — [XX% complete, blocker if any]

TECHNICAL DECISIONS
→ [Decision made with rationale and alternatives considered]

PERFORMANCE
- API p50: XXms | p99: XXms
- Scoring latency p50: XXms | p99: XXms
- Error rate: X.XX%
- Test coverage: XX%

NEXT SPRINT
- [Top 3 priorities]

BLOCKERS
- [None / specific items needing help]
```

---

## 3. Customer Communication

**When to use:** Product updates, outages, feature launches
**Tone:** Friendly, clear, creator-focused, no jargon

### Feature Launch Announcement

```
Subject: NEW: [Feature Name] is live 🚀

Hi [Name],

[One sentence describing the feature and why it matters to them]

Here's what's new:
• [Benefit 1 — specific and concrete]
• [Benefit 2 — specific and concrete]
• [Benefit 3 — specific and concrete]

[If applicable: Screenshot or GIF showing the feature]

How to try it:
1. [Step 1]
2. [Step 2]
3. [Step 3]

[CTA button: Try it now]

As always, hit reply and let us know what you think.
We read every email.

— The Signal OS Team
```

### Service Outage Update

```
Subject: Resolved: Brief service interruption [TIME]

Hi [Name],

Earlier today, from [start time] to [end time] UTC, some users 
experienced [brief description of issue].

What happened: [1-2 sentence plain English explanation]
What we did: [How it was fixed]
What's next: [Prevention measure]

No action is needed on your part. Everything is back to normal.

We know you rely on Signal OS for your content. We're sorry 
for any disruption this caused. Our full postmortem is here: [link]

— [Name] from Engineering
```

## 4. Partner / Integration Communication

**When to use:** API updates, partnership discussions, integration requests
**Tone:** Professional, technical detail, mutual benefit focus

### Partnership Proposal

```
Subject: Partnership: [Their Company] × Signal OS

Hi [Name],

[Their company] and Signal OS share a common goal: helping creators 
succeed on X. I see a natural integration opportunity.

The Opportunity
- [Their tool] does [X] exceptionally well
- Signal OS does [Y] exceptionally well (content intelligence)
- Together: creators get [Z benefit]

What We're Proposing
[Specific integration or partnership structure]

What's In It For [Their Company]
• [Benefit 1: e.g., "Access to 12K+ creators in our user base"]
• [Benefit 2: e.g., "Co-marketing on Product Hunt launch"]
• [Benefit 3: e.g., "Revenue share on referrals"]

Next Steps
I'd love to get on a 20-minute call to discuss. 
How's [specific time options]?

— [Your name], [Title], Signal OS
```

**Tone:** Transparent, metric-heavy, forward-looking

KEY METRICS
┌────────────────┬──────────┬──────────┬──────────┐

## 6. Public Communication (Status Page)

**When to use:** Public status updates during incidents
**Tone:** Transparent, factual, reassuring

### Status Page Templates

**Investigating:**
> We are investigating reports of [issue]. Some users may experience [symptom]. We will provide updates as more information becomes available. [Timestamp]

**Identified:**
> We have identified the cause of [issue] as [root cause]. Our team is actively working on a fix. We expect resolution within [ETA]. [Timestamp]

**Monitoring:**
> A fix has been deployed for [issue]. We are monitoring the situation closely and will confirm once full recovery is verified. [Timestamp]

**Resolved:**
> [Issue] has been fully resolved as of [time]. All services are operating normally. A postmortem will be published within 24 hours at [link]. [Timestamp]

## 7. All-Hands Meeting Template

**When to use:** Monthly company all-hands
**Tone:** Energetic, transparent, inclusive

```

🎉 CELEBRATIONS
[Ships, wins, customer feedback]

📊 THE NUMBERS
[Key metrics, visually presented]

🚧 WHAT WE'RE BUILDING
[Product roadmap update with demos]

[Top 3 priorities everyone should know]

🗣️ OPEN FLOOR
[Questions, feedback, shoutouts]
```
